narrative.intro: Acquisition Logistics obligated $609M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Acquisition Logistics won 5 awards in the period, with an average award size of $122M, and obligations were up 131.5% year over year. Acquisition Logistics received the vast majority of its FY2026 obligations from the Department of Homeland Security, which obligated $598M. Acquisition Logistics recorded smaller purchases from the Department of Defense, which obligated $10.8M. Acquisition Logistics sold services categorized under Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services, which accounted for $609M, and also recorded obligations under Other Support Activities for Water Transportation totaling $311K. Historical obligations show that Acquisition Logistics had lower annual totals in prior years, including $263M in FY25 and single-digit millions in earlier fiscal years, before the FY26 increase. The current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date, and the award-value tables report total contract values rather than obligations.
